title: Full SS14 botany grown-plant catalog: 65 new visual families
target_runtime: Minecraft Java 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.224; native Java block-model JSON, PNG and native texture animation only
brief: Implement the art-only grown-plant extension specified in docs/botany-genetics-sprint/PLANT-MODEL-BRIEF.md. Its exact 65-family table, stage counts, RSI sources, animation dispositions, aliases, root/binding/export contract, attribution and source-fidelity early checkpoint are mandatory. Reuse and preserve the five existing plant families and corrected tray from the canonical BasicBotany package; no duplicate/remade accepted art. The catalog contains 71 seed IDs and 70 grown-plant RSI families; fake/real capfruit share one commissioned family. Every family needs all declared growth stages plus identifiable harvest/dead states. All referenced required RSI states were verified present at the source pin. Complete editable masters, native exports, flat destination manifest, explicit seed/visual/resource mapping, source/provenance/licenses, original-first previews and read-only validation are required. Plant-only request: produce/packet/mob/weapon/tool output assets and runtime mechanics are separate audited work, not hidden scope. See the full brief for animation, envelope exceptions, preservation and acceptance boundaries. Authoring starts with the representative source-first design gate, not blanket batch generation. Delivery is not owner acceptance, import or gameplay parity.
